question: How much did gambling-industry donors give to each party, and which party's MPs spoke most about gambling?

payload.answer:
A later Senate passage says the major parties were given more than $10 million by gambling companies and lobby groups.

A Greens-indexed Senate motion states the gambling industry donated almost $3 million to the Liberal, Labor and Australian Conservatives parties in 2017-18.

Another representatives passage gives Labor about $5 million.

sources.title: Larissa Waters — MOTIONS — 2019-02-13
sources.speaker: Larissa Waters
sources.snippet:
I move:

That the Senate—

(a) notes that:

(i) the gambling industry donated almost $3 million dollars to the Liberal, Labor and Australian Conservatives political parties in 2017-18,

(ii) these donations came from sports betting companies, casinos and poker machine operators,

(iii) the Australian Hotels Association was the second largest political donor in the country for the 2017-18 year, with declared political gifts leaping from $153,000 in 2016-17 to $1.1 million last financial year,
